# FDX fixtures

`TestFDX-FD.fdx` is a file saved by Final Draft, taken from
[wildwinter/screenplay-tools](https://github.com/wildwinter/screenplay-tools)
(`tests/TestFDX-FD.fdx`, commit `d0fc871`), MIT licence, copyright (c) 2024 Ian
Thomas. It is test data only.

The richer cases (styled runs, dual dialogue, a shot, a lettered scene number,
a revision mark) are built from it inside `tests/test_fdx.py`, following the
structure of this file. Script notes and tags are not covered, because no real
file with them was available (ADR 0014).
